title: Audited Override and Continue
scope: Implement explicit, auditable safe advisory overrides in the active Build 51 measurement workflow without unrelated redesign, data, or architecture work.
objectives: Preserve abnormal entered measurements and explain advisory warnings and recommended rechecks.
Require deliberate Override & Continue action for safe advisory warnings across Beginner, Seasoned, Pro, and compatible Novice guidance.
Persist complete override evidence with the correct job/workflow and expose it in Tune Log/audit history.
Keep genuine hard stops non-overridable and regression-test all required behavior at browser level.
constraints: Do not modify vehicle data, build unrelated features, migrate architecture, or visually redesign CarbTune.
Do not normalize an abnormal value, overwrite specifications/recommendations, silently dismiss warnings, or fabricate evidence.
Preserve existing localStorage jobs and Novice compatibility.
AFR remains optional without an installed wideband sensor.

acceptanceTests.expected: All 20 audited override acceptance requirements pass through actual browser behavior.
acceptanceTests.evidence: tests/validate-workflow.cjs adds 34 browser assertions covering the full acceptance and phone UX contract within a 126-assertion workflow run.

acceptanceTests.expected: Baseline and two post-change npm run validate runs exit zero.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Baseline passed 5 programs/92 assertions; two final post-change runs each passed 5 programs/126 assertions.
git diff --exit-code confirms data/vehicle-applications.js is unchanged from baseline.

implementationNotes: Added backward-compatible workflow.overrideAudit normalization and structured WARNING_OVERRIDE records.
Classified plausible out-of-working-range readings as safe advisories and technically implausible readings as non-overridable hard stops.
Added deliberate Correct / Recheck and Override & Continue controls with guidance-specific copy and optional technician reason.
Mirrored override evidence into Tune Log history without altering the original measurement, specifications, or recommendations.
Added browser interaction, persistence, history, guidance, in-range, hard-stop, AFR, and legacy regression coverage.

validation.summary: Pre-change suite passed 5 programs/92 workflow assertions. Two required final post-change runs each passed all 5 programs and 126 workflow assertions.
